status: PROPOSAL. Implements the AR-1 strict option 1 receipt-contract amendment A1-1..A1-6 (k2/D2-ANALYSIS-r2 section 4). Not approved; do not treat as the ratified contract.
note: Synthetic only. Every secret is sha256('rooftopos-ar1-kat-synthetic|<key_id>') and must never be provisioned. Key ids carry a kat- prefix so they can never collide with the real -2 ids (stg-<app>-2, gw-<app>-2). Attacker stand-ins use sha256('rooftopos-ar1-kat-synthetic|attacker-guess|<key_id>').

contract.gateway_confirmation: issuer gateway, recipient source_app, prev_receipt_sha256 = digest(adm_S), signed with gw-<source>, issued only after the Gateway verified and stored the target chain; held gets none until final
contract.source_rule: the source MAC-verifies exactly [adm_S] or [adm_S, gateway_confirmation] with its own store; target receipts are evidence only
contract.admission_per_recipient: adm_T has the same unsigned fields as adm_S except key_id; signed with gw-<target>, signed once, stored, reused byte for byte on every retry; it is the rtgip-admission-receipt header and the anchor (prev) of target_inbox
contract.key_audience: app keys: owner <app>, audience gateway. Gateway keys: owner gateway, audience <app>, bound only to connections that app is an end of. A key with no audience is unusable
contract.receipt_query_response: {reason:null, receipts:[adm_S] or [adm_S, gateway_confirmation], target_evidence:[adm_T, target_inbox, consumer_commit?] (unverified at the source)}
contract.h4_direct_export: retired: no app holds another app's key
